items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Well, Taylor had a small band. They all was from New Orleans. I'll tell you who they was. Two of those men is dead now. Two brothers. There's Willie Young and Austin Young.

ctx.x: I was going to ask before we go on about these bands. In Taylor's band, were they all from New

Orleans, all the other fellas? Well, Taylor had a small band. They all was from New Orleans. I'll tell you who they was. Two of those men is dead now. Two brothers. There's Willie Young and Austin Young.

Oh, yeah. Called Sporting Boots. Yeah. I knew, well, I heard, let's see, Boots is the Austin Young, the bass player. Right, right. I even made some records with him way back. He was a great drummer. Ten years or so ago. At that time. Yeah. And told me he lost his teeth and he took up bass. I only took him on bass. Right. I heard his brother once at the taxi dance hall someplace. La Vida. One of those places someplace. And I never did really get to know it. Wow. His name was Willie Young. Called him Sporting.
